title: The Queen's Gambit
event_title: The Queen's Gambit is released on Netflix
event_note: Views of the article began climbing two days before release, with the trailer and reviews.
lede: A Netflix drama about a chess prodigy, followed step by step: from what people looked up, to what they reached for, to what they borrowed and bought.
description: A time-ordered ripple map for The Queen's Gambit: each step dated and marked by how it was measured.
limits: Wikipedia stands in for all attention and one city's library for borrowing. Timing shows order, not proof that the event caused each step on its own.
dataline: Wikimedia pageviews (daily), Seattle Public Library checkouts (monthly), NPD Group

steps.title: People look up chess
steps.note: Readers also went to chess clocks and openings.
steps.test: Named-subject test: z = 4 against 200 fake dates (p = 0.01); family passes (ledger 1458, 1470).

steps.title: Interest turns to playing: chess sets and online chess
steps.note: Attention moved from the game to the gear and places to play.

steps.title: Chess sets and chess books sell
steps.measure: NPD Group, the three weeks after release, reported 24 November 2020
steps.note: NPD said chess set sales had been flat for 13 weeks before the show. Reported by NPD, not measured by us.
